# KUMIHAN JA v0.2.0 — follow-up acceptance QA

## Authority and boundaries
- Owner authorized additional QA on 2026-10-20; **not** main merge, tag, Release, Pages deployment or Marketplace submission.
- Target candidate: Draft PR #120 at initial HEAD ce2fd8d23e4afb0816b5870625e02af3aa7a96b8; Fresh Read required before running.
- Dedicated QA control branch: control/ja-v020-qa-20261020, based on PR #120 HEAD. It holds instructions/evidence planning only. Existing PR #120 should remain Draft.
- [W00–W08 QA Workgroup](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/control/ja-v020-qa-20261020/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/qa/WORKGROUP.md)
- [Visual observation findings](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/control/ja-v020-qa-20261020/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/qa/QA_OBSERVATIONS.md)
- [30-case / six-gate JSON matrix](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/control/ja-v020-qa-20261020/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/qa/QA_MATRIX.json)
- [Native host smoke protocol](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/control/ja-v020-qa-20261020/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/qa/HOST_SMOKE.md)

## Confirmed preliminary observations (from prior evidence and independent visual read)
- **QA-V01 P0 positive specimen:** PV-006 preserved long UI label but splits オンライン across rows as オ/ンライン in screenshots; JA-TYPE-004 remains needs-review. PV-005 remains deliberate failed negative control. Do not claim the plugin itself caused the split.
- **QA-V02 P1 fallback:** synthetic source-version fragment displays v0.1.8Source v0.2.0 with no separator. Test actual Jekyll CSS/accessible text before deciding production impact.
- Prior candidate is 96-test/15-ZIP CI-backed, 11 partly-run cases and 19 not-run. Native v0.2.0 host installation not established; current live Universal MCP JA version 0.1.8.

## Work queue
- [ ] W00 Fresh Read and immutable candidate baseline
- [ ] W01 Reproduce/fix positive sample linebreak and text-only version-panel separator if confirmed
- [ ] W02 Generate and fully render actual Japanese Web artifact at 320/375/768/1024/1440 and user overrides
- [ ] W03 Generate real PDF report and 8+ slide PPTX, inspect every page/slide visually
- [ ] W04 Native-install/route the 4 skills in supported host test environments, or report exact ACCESS_NEEDED
- [ ] W05 Risk-focused PV-case closure without inventing 30/30 pass
- [ ] W06 Recheck final-head 15 ZIPs / preserved other languages / schema / CI / site version distinction
- [ ] W07 Independent reviewer and bounded fixes on QA work branch; Draft stacked PR targeting feature candidate
- [ ] W08 Publish evidence-based RESULT.md to this issue and #119; stop at Owner Gate

Codex Cloud/App invocation is **manual using START_HERE**; this issue does not launch it. Any limitations of actual native hosts must stay NOT-CHECKED, not simulated PASS. Issue #119 tracks the main v0.2.0 update.

### Result expected
Final SHA/TREE, changed paths, exact commands/outcomes, per-artifact screenshots, 30-case status deltas, host identity/invocation or named blocker, 15 hashes, review findings and Owner decision options. No release without separate explicit Owner authorization.

Source: [QA_V01_PROBE.md](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/control/ja-v020-qa-20261020/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/qa/QA_V01_PROBE.md)
